Pavilion features

The perfect spot for family and friends to gather and relax. We build many sizes ranging from 8' x 8' to 16' x 48'.

  • Authentic timber frame appeal
  • 6" x 6" timbers
  • Railings on all sides
  • (2) openings
  • 1" pressure treated deckboards
  • Stained
  • Roof pitch varies by width

Available in-stock or custom order, with easy rent-to-own.

Metal roof colors: Burgundy, Brown, Bronze, Ivy, Charcoal, Red, Black, Ocean Blue (black standard; special colors +$300).
Stain colors: Natural, Driftwood, Red Cedar, Chestnut Brown.
Specs: rough sawn native Spruce, Pine or Hemlock framing; 4" x 4" rot-resistant timbers; 2" x 6" floor joists 16" on center; Larch available for 10% more.

Our timber frame pavilions are rustic structures sold without warranty; the Lifetime Warranty covers our vinyl and LP SmartSide buildings. Rustic timbers turn color in 1–2 seasons.
